messages:
Maya: Quick sync on the launch webinar ops — need owners for registration UX, Zoom fallback, captions, recording splits, and the post-event lead flow. Goal: smooth live experience + 24h replay + benchmark follow-up. Who takes what? :calendar:

Ethan: I can own the inbound lead flow and HubSpot mapping. Will ensure UTM fields and experiment flags carry through. Suggest hidden fields: utm_campaign, utm_source, ab_variant. Also verify GDPR consent checkbox for EU regs.

Sam: Ill take Zoom fallback/RTMP. Plan: primary Zoom webinar with cloud recording, RTMP to StreamYard as hot-failover. I'll run RTMP key dry-run tonight and again during dress rehearsal. If StreamYard engaged, I'll switch host to StreamYard and flip the public banner.

Priya: I'll do registration page copy + follow-up cadence. Drafting 2 hero variants that emphasize either "benchmark results" or "engineering demo"  will A/B test on a small internal list. Follow-ups: immediate replay email (1hr), benchmark PDF + highlights (24h), and segmented nurture based on engagement (72h).

Luis: I'll own accessibility/captions. Enabling Zoom auto-captions live, then run the SRT through our postprocess to generate speaker-labeled VTT and searchable transcript. Drop artifacts to S3 path `s3://redwood-marketing/launches/2026-04/`. Also ensure player supports sidecar .vtt.

Maya: Good. A few details: 1) Recording splits  clip by speaker + full session  need someone to own exporting clips to S3 and making clips available to CMS. 2) If live fails >10min, we show a banner on reg page and send SMS alerts for registrants who opted in.

Ethan: On HubSpot side: Zap flow will be 
- Create/Update contact with consent and utms 
- Add contact to webinar workflow 
- Add activity event type = webinar_launch_apr 
I'll test dedupe rules; existing contact should get an activity not a duplicate contact. Will post test logs.

Sam: RTMP test snippet for ops notes:
```
RTMP endpoint: rtmp://rtmp.streamyard.com/live/STREAMKEY
OBS: bitrate 3500k, keyframe 2s, resolution 1280x720
```
Ran test @ 21:15 PT, stable for 10m. Will rehearse 09:00 PT tomorrow.

Priya: Quick on copy variants: hero_a emphasizes "See the latency & cost numbers"; hero_b emphasizes "How we serve large models at scale". I'll tag each registrant with ab_variant on submit so Ethan can slice later. Also drafting follow-up subject lines for each variant.

Luis: Caption pipeline note: after auto-caption, run speaker-detect -> regenerate .vtt and a small QC script that flags >5% word-error-rate for manual review. Also timestamp align speaker JSON for CMS highlight snippets.

Maya: OK final checklist: Ethan  hidden fields + HubSpot Zap test; Sam  RTMP keys + dress rehearsal; Luis  caption pipeline + S3 drop; Priya  reg page variants + follow-ups. Post here when each done. Rehearsal 09:00 PT tomorrow. :rocket:
